networkAccess.reasoning: Loads the Noto Sans web font used by the brand type ramp. Dual File Mode reads the library files the user configures (variables and published components) from the Figma REST API. UX AI and the UX AI agents send questions and the text of the reviewed layers, with the matching library context, to the AI provider the user picks in Settings (Claude at api.anthropic.com, OpenAI at api.openai.com or Gemini at generativelanguage.googleapis.com) using the user's own API key. In development the Jira tab calls the local Jira proxy (npm run jira:proxy) on localhost:8787. Publish commits design-system releases (token JSON, release notes, changelog) to the GitHub repository the user configures, opens the pull request and follows its GitHub Actions run, using the user's own access token (api.github.com). When the user ticks "Post the changelog to Teams", Publish posts the release changelog to the Microsoft Teams Incoming Webhook (*.webhook.office.com) or Power Automate trigger (*.logic.azure.com) the user pasted in Settings › Notifications.
